pages.title: About Lanternworks
pages.description: Who Lanternworks Studio is and how we approach brand and web work.

sections.heading: About Lanternworks
paragraphs: Lanternworks Studio designs and builds websites for teams who need their site to do real work: carry a brand, support paid campaigns, and convert a click into an enquiry.
This six-page site replaces our previous single page at lanternworks.com. Every section you see here, from the homepage hero to this page, runs on the same system we hand off to clients.

aside.heading: What we do
aside.text: Brand design, web design, and the build to ship it, all under one roof.

sections.label: Approach
sections.text: We design in the open. Decisions about type, color, and motion get made in front of the client, not behind one. What ships is what we agreed to.

pages.title: Services
pages.description: Brand identity, web design, and web build, as separate or combined engagements.

sections.heading: What we offer
paragraphs: Lanternworks works across three disciplines: brand identity, web design, and web build. Most projects use all three; some need just one.

sections.heading: Services
sections.intro: Pick a starting point. Most engagements combine more than one.

items.name: Brand Identity
items.summary: Logo, color, type, and the rules that keep them consistent across every surface.

items.name: Web Design
items.summary: Page-by-page design for marketing sites, product sites, and campaign landing pages.

items.name: Web Build
items.summary: A built, deployed site, not just a file. We hand off code we also maintain.

items.q: Do you design or build, or both?
items.a: Both. We design the pages and we build the site that ships, so nothing gets lost moving from file to site.

items.q: Can you take on just one piece, like the logo?
items.a: Yes. Brand identity, web design, and web build are each their own engagement if that's what you need.

pages.title: How We Work
pages.description: The four-step sequence every Lanternworks project runs through.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: Every project runs through the same sequence, whether it's a logo or a six-page build. The steps don't change; the scope does.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We start with what you're trying to do and who the site has to convince.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Pages get designed in sequence, starting with the one visitors land on first.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The approved design becomes a real, deployed site, not a set of static images.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: The site goes live and we hand off what you need to keep running it.
